reason: The cited README line describes the tool as searching indexed public GitHub issue, pull-request, and README content. That establishes it can return public GitHub content, which is attacker-controllable, so UNTRUSTED is supported. It explicitly concerns public content, not non-public host/SaaS data, so SECRET is not supported. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution or delivering agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported.
